files.README.md:
# Pumplock Harbourmaster - pump-out service log

logs/service.log takes one line per run:

    <date> <time> PUMPOUT slip <slip> "<boat>" <gal> gal COMPLETE operator <name>

Only completed runs are logged; aborted runs wait until they are
re-run. Log lines carry the ticket sheet's date and the duty
operator named on it. Tickets are kept in notes/.
